notes.text: The leaf has no secure authorial page number. Bottom-left 61 is thin lighter foliation in another unnamed hand. There are 19 main baselines, a slanted square, two sloping margin notes and several additions. The De façon équivalente introduction remains live; broad lower cancellation starts at the later a) clause.

In continuing item b), the author describes a factorisation through the displayed Sigma(1) map, introduces p2, asks for the square to be Cartesian and writes a transversality condition involving p1 and immersion-but. This is an account of his text, not a verification. The crowded second tuple component remains p1 b′/p1∘b′; a composition sign is not supplied with certainty.

The square retains two descending diagonals, four separate upper hook fragments, two lower hook fragments, a small lower-shaft gap and an elongated open retracing near its right end. The upper shaft has an upturned endpoint without a complete head. p2 is above/right of its diagonal and b is above the lower shaft. These are observations of ink.

The upper NB discusses separatedness, properness and a closed-embedding conclusion in the author's own argument; this reading does not verify that argument. Its opening parenthesis-like curve has a lower tail beneath Si and no written closing partner. The second note records the author's doubt: cette condition de transversalité est peut être conséquence des autres, followed by a point and short stroke. The missing hyphen is preserved.

The author inserts séparé after espace topologique and writes the curved relation sign transcribed preceq. He cancels dont le graphe est and inserts satisfaisant les conditions suivantes. The cancelled draft describes a graph, inserts stricte and bordante, then presents another a) clause with Sigma_<x and an inserted equality. The final baseline has doubtful ens/est, (fini), tot with raised t and an external stop, and independently underlined ordonné. The small doubtful est and un/une groups above/right are retained without using them to repair this baseline.

Two detached points near x1583–1599,y1752–1770 have no secure textual function. They are reproduced as graphic marks in the margin, inventoried and separately boxed, without punctuating the sentence. The cancelled interline Sigma, four word/phrase insertions, final inserted equality and rightmost faint lower group are all retained.

Only the assigned images, witnesses and notation snapshot were used. No OCR, outside source or proof check was used. The opening label, overwritten exponents/subscript, cancelled prefix and small final groups remain the least secure readings.
